title: Synthetic Anatomy for Radiological Applications - Generating a Functional MRI Phantom
summary: SARA developed physical models for testing functional MRI measurements. An MRI phantom is an object with known properties that researchers scan to check acquisition and analysis methods.

The Signal Generating phantom produces a controlled changing signal for testing fMRI workflows. Its public resources include MRI data, analysis code, manufacturing files, and a containerised workflow.

figures.caption: Construction of the SiGn phantom, from a digital brain-slice mesh to the printed model and gel-filled assembly. GM, WM, and CSF label the grey matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid compartments.
